description: Get a link that opens Kulhad sign-up with a page name already filled in. Hand it to the person setting up the page; they finish it themselves in a browser. This does not create an account and cannot. It marks the name as taken for check_username_available for fifteen minutes; it does not stop anyone signing up with that name directly. Nothing is sent.
